title: On a running test install, an empty board for 30 minutes yields at most three unreleased draft items listed in master status
description: Starts a real temporary Postgres control plane with no open items and an empty-board alarm held for over 30 minutes; one loop cycle launches a headless planner session that files at most three unreleased draft items with why and simplest and no criteria, and master status lists them under attention with their keys.

steps.name: running test install with an empty board for 30 minutes yields at most three unreleased draft items listed in master status
